skills.name: Elegant Tea Time
skills.description: Relaxes with an elegant spot of tea.  Good effects on allies.  *HP +300% (10 sec) *Evade Rate +30% (10 sec) *Reflects 250% of incoming skill damage as physical damage (10 sec)

skills.name: Flux - Sharp Strike
skills.description: Swiftly moves behind enemies and delivers a sharp strike from behind.  *ATK x 4000% Area Damage  *Enemy ATK -60% (7 sec) *Enemy Hit Rate -60% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: WIND BREAKER
abilities.description: WIND BREAKER Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback: Agility
abilities.description: Has a high chance of knocking back all Agility type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
